summary: Iteration 55 - Tested all single pass fixes: Staff-guest linking, Portal navigation, Guest delete, Country code field, ID Number rename, Group removal from staff profiles, Donor flag removal from staff flags, Kiosk locked mode. All tests passed.

(6) Donor flag removed from UserEditDialog Flags tab (only shows Is Parent, Is Guest, Is Customer). (7) Kiosk locked mode hides Exit link, Setup, and Logout buttons. (8) Staff-guest linking with user_id tested via API.
